row.name: Underworld Savvy
row.description: Characters from the galaxy's shadowy underbelly possess practical street knowledge, illicit contacts, and a knack for navigating dangerous situations. Benefits: Contacts (Criminal or Smuggler, 3 points) (representing connections in the underworld, subject to GM approval for specific contacts). +1 to Streetwise (IQ/Average) and Scrounging (IQ/Easy) skills. (These bonuses apply after buying skill levels.) Intuition (5 points) (representing a gut feeling for trouble or opportunity). These are the tools of survival and opportunism in a ruthless galaxy. Such individuals excel at operating outside the law, exploiting loopholes, and prioritizing personal gain or the survival of their immediate crew over abstract ideals.
